sources.researchNote: The Commons metadata lists 1949 and records an upload on 27 September 2018. The listed year cannot be accepted as the date when this portrait was taken, since Lubitsch died in 1947. The photography date is unestablished; the meaning of the 1949 metadata date has not been determined. The description follows the file page rather than examination of the object in the holding institution.

media.title: Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar — portrait photograph
media.description: Portrait photograph of film director Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar. Photographer unidentified; Fundo Correio da Manhã, Arquivo Nacional (Brazil), via Wikimedia Commons. The Commons metadata lists 1949, but that date requires caution because Lubitsch died in 1947.
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait of film director Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The Wikimedia Commons file comes from the Arquivo Nacional (Brazil), Fundo Correio da Manhã (accession BR_RJANRIO_PH_0_FOT_30541_002), and carries the Arquivo Nacional licence template with the PD-Brazil-URAA ground. That template records a faithful reproduction of public-domain material, not a release by the archive, and its ground holds only for a work first published in Brazil. This photograph is a Hollywood studio portrait: the same image, signed by Lubitsch, is reproduced by the Mary Pickford Foundation, so the newspaper’s print was a distributed publicity still rather than a Brazilian first publication. Its United States status turns on when it was published and whether it carried a notice, neither of which is attested; the Commons date of 1949 is two years after Lubitsch’s death and was already disputed on Commons. The status is therefore left undetermined; the local copy is used for scholarly identification.
